title: armeria leucocephala subsp. soleirolii
intro: Armeria leucocephala subsp. soleirolii, commonly known as the Maritime Thrift or Sea Thrift, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Plantaginaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including bronchitis, coughs, and respiratory problems, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Armeria leucocephala subsp. soleirolii include stimulating the production of mucus, reducing inflammation, and relieving congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its health benefits.
